ops.body:
Revert the auto-ensure
Question: Any ordinary reposync command can re-enable a service you deliberately disabled, because daemonkit v0.36.0's loadOnce always runs `launchctl enable`, and nothing in daemonkit reads launchd's disabled flag. The explicit `reposync install` and the automatic startup check go through the same Ensure call, so a correct fix needs a daemonkit API change. Which way should I build the candidate?
Options: Fix in daemonkit (Recommended) | reposync-only stopgap | Stopgap now, SDK later | Revert the auto-ensure
